known_defects.summary: Repeated labels on sibling links cannot reach 0 ambiguous owners in this build: v1 2/4, v2 2/8, v3 2/8, v4 0/4.
known_defects.mechanism: ports on one box side are always 2 cells apart (router.rs port_cell: along = 1 + 2*slot), while place_label puts a vertical-run label len/2+1+gap cells to the side, so the sibling lane is closer to the text than the text's own lane for every repeated 4-9 char label. The engine's structural fix - the reserved label slot for a labelled edge that spans two ranks - never reaches the router in this build: lib.rs builds every EdgeSpec with label_slot: None, so reserve_label_slot is dead code. Measured directly: v2 with minlen:2 label ranks still reports 2 ambiguous (check-v2-a2-labelrank.txt) and so does v4 in tb (check-v4-a1-access.txt).
known_defects.mitigation_measured: lr puts the label beside a horizontal run (ownership distance 1) and reaches 0 ambiguous: v4 final (0/4) and v2 attempt a3 (0/8, but extent 80x19 overflows 77 columns, so it could not be adopted within the 3-attempt budget).

blockers: Multi-group region rendering (D1): with 2+ declared groups only one region box wraps its members; the rest collapse to a sliver. Round 08 cannot claim 'every group renders as one bordered, titled region' with this binary.

Repeated-label ownership (D2): reserved label slots are unreachable from the app, so repeated labels on 2-cell-apart ports cannot reach 0 ambiguous owners except by switching the view to lr, which is not available for the fabric view because the source pins the spines above the leaves.

Reversed-edge arrowheads (D3): the renderer has no way to keep a leaf->spine arrow's head on the near side when the spines are pinned above the leaf row; the honest direction therefore costs loops and crossings in the fabric view.
